It will assess the state-of-the-art for maritime LCTs andevaluate the constraints imposed by dynamic maritime environments, such as sea waves. Following this analysis, existing Pointing, Acquisition, andTracking (PAT) mechanisms, optical head mechanical designand optical communication systems will be benchmarked, and one will be selected andoptimised for effective performance in maritimeconditions. A prototype MLCT will be developed with Size, Weight, and Power (SWaP) specifications closeto a final product, ensuring compatibility with current and future planned space LCTs. The MLCT shall be designed for manufacturability at a competitivecommercial cost. The possibility of a test to be conducted with a satellite LCT should be explored
